concerns.text: FR‑006 requires exactly 1000 permutations for tree‑based models. Task T044, which should enforce this, is still pending, allowing an adaptive count that weakens the specification.
FR‑005 mandates a hold‑out split with disjoint elemental sets. The required tasks (T042, T043, T046) are unchecked, so the disjointness constraint is not enforced, violating the spec.
Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires checksums for all dataset files, yet no task records or verifies checksums for any file under `data/`.
Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) demands that every figure/statistic trace to a unique data row and code block. No task creates or records this provenance linkage.
Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline) requires content‑hash tracking for all artifacts. No task implements hash generation or state‑file updates.
Setup tasks T001a (directory structure) and T001b (`__init__.py` files) remain incomplete, breaking the prerequisite that the project’s package layout be established before any code can be imported.
Documentation tasks that generate the README, quickstart guide, and its validation are still pending, leaving essential usage instructions undocumented and unverified.
